title: Comedic Timing: Exploratory Research Snapshot
description:
First archived snapshot of the exploratory comedic timing research pipeline. It includes source code, tests, experiment protocols, public-domain-derived stimulus text, and research reports. Audio, model weights, raw run records, participant responses, and private practice materials are not included. This is a research snapshot, not a completed benchmark.

License scope: The MIT License applies only to original project source code identified in LICENSE. Research reports, stimulus text, datasets, figures, generated outputs, and third-party material are excluded from this grant and retain their applicable existing terms.
